In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +16.9 and D +1.7. A normal polling error decides it.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Cyndi Munson runs furthest behind in Le Flore, Washington, Mayes. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

The forecast's worst groups for Cyndi Munson: Immigration voters 17 to 80, Small counties 29 to 68, White voters 35 to 63. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
